overall_reason: The rows carry status words and facts ('Live', 'Building', 'Failed', 'perf/search · b41e09d · Jon Park · 42s'), but every row shows the same duration, '42s'.

score.reason: T-STATE-COPY passes on the status words 'Live', 'Building' and 'Failed'; T-THREE-LINE flags the repeated '42s', and the four-part meta line is cut off at both widths.

findings.where: meta line under each deploy, 1440 and 375 (01-evidence/tiles/1440-00.png)
findings.evidence: The DOM meta lines read 'main · 8f2c1a4 · Maya Chen · 42s', 'perf/search · b41e09d · Jon Park · 42s' and 'copy/pricing · 3a7f6c2 · Ana Ruiz · 42s'. On screen they are cut to 'Maya Chen ·', 'b41e09d · J' and '3a7f6c2 · Ana', so the author and duration are lost.
findings.after: Keep two facts in the meta line (branch and author), move the duration to the status column, and give each deploy its real duration
findings.why: Three different builds with one duration read as filler. A line of four facts that is cut off hides the author the reader scans for.

strengths: The status words 'Live', 'Building' and 'Failed' state each deploy's outcome in plain words.
not_investigated: T-LONG-FORM: no running-text region; the item is a single product composition with under 50 words.
T-FIVE-SECOND and T-RIVAL-NAME on interface labels: skipped, the item is an app component (Operate mode) with no hero; page title and navigation sit outside the capture frame.
T-READ-ALOUD: no brand voice supplied and too few sentences to hear a voice.
Async and after-action states: async.json was not captured, so no state copy after a click was read.
The truncation itself is a layout fault; it is cited only because it hides words.
